answer: Three random lagoon members — drawn by public lottery, not the applicant — must vouch each new identity. Each vouchee locks a crystal bond of 5 credits, freed after 20 epochs. A 400-clone farmer cannot stack the lottery: two clones sharing a panel is near-impossible, so each clone needs three honest vouches at 5 credits risk each. The signal each applicant sends is its written request; honest vouchees reject incoherent ones, so clones face a coherence gate scaling with panels. Corrupting one vouchee helps one applicant. Attacker cost scales with clone count; an honest newcomer pays once.
